sources.title: Common operating policy: information handling (v1)
sources.body: Internal response codes belong to one operator. Shared handoffs may carry operational decisions and source citations, but must omit internal response codes. Missing approval-ticket records must be reported as unknown; an adopted policy is not a ticket receipt.

sources.title: Quartz equipment loan: area policy (v1)
sources.body: For Quartz equipment loan, the north area policy is adopted. Its limit is 45 kits. It takes effect on 2026-06-01. A proposal does not authorize work.

sources.title: Quartz equipment loan: area policy (v2)
sources.body: For Quartz equipment loan, the north area policy is withdrawn; no work is authorized from 2026-06-10. The earlier policy is superseded. No replacement limit has been adopted.

sources.title: Quartz equipment loan: eligibility conditions (v1)
sources.body: Work for Quartz equipment loan in the north area may proceed only when its area policy is adopted and remaining trained staff is at least 5. A withdrawn or proposed policy blocks work regardless of the measurement. The threshold uses the current measurement log, not the planning estimate.

sources.title: Quartz equipment loan: measurement log (v1)
sources.body: The current remaining trained staff for Quartz equipment loan in the north area is 7. This is the checked reading. The planning estimate was 12, and must not be used for the eligibility decision. No approval-ticket receipt is included in this log.

sources.title: Quartz equipment loan: handoff instructions (v1)
sources.body: For Quartz equipment loan in the north area, Lena 1 is the site coordinator. The next operator must receive the loan ledger. Retain this handoff record for 14 days. A signed receipt proves delivery but does not replace the named handoff item. This handoff rule is independent of policy revisions and remains in force after a withdrawal.
